ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Leftover broth and soured rice are food already served and gone bad. The records use that unappetizing meal for inherited sayings or second-hand answers offered after someone else has already consumed them.
EvidenceBody: Mingyin and Huitong compare repeating buddhas, patriarchs, old cases, and current cases to the spoiled meal. Deshan refuses the cooking cloth because no leftovers are available, while an unnamed monk tells Xuefeng that someone has already eaten them.
